messages:
maya: Quick preflight — RC rc-2026-03-17-1 is baked and ready. Requesting greenlight for a 22:00-23:00 PT prod window. Major items: DB migration v3 (online, no data loss), model-serving config switch, and Redis key format change.

alex: What's the dependency matrix? Are there library bumps that need coord with infra?

maya: @alex nothing big; python deps pinned. Biggest risk is the DB ALTER that adds an indexed column — we ran it in staging with zero downtime prep.

samir: Can we canary first? Suggest 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m if metrics OK.

li: DB migration has a short exclusive lock step (~30s) when we backfill the new index. We should do that during the window and warn write-heavy services.

qa-jen: Can someone paste the smoke checklist? I can run quick verifications once canary is up.

deploy-bot: [CI] All checks passed — unit: 412/412, integration: 124/124, e2e: passed, infra-scan: low. Artifact: rc-2026-03-17-1.

deploy-bot: To promote run:
```
/deploy promote rc-2026-03-17-1 --env prod --window "22:00-23:00 PT" --canary 5%:15m,25%:10m --rollback-tag rc-2026-02-28-9
```

ops-sheriff: Who is oncall for the window? Need one SRE + a runtime engineer.

maya: I'll be the runtime lead. @samir will do the canary monitoring. @li will own DB step.

alex: Please pin the model-serving image and set autoscaling buffer to +20% during rollout. Also enable automatic fallback to previous image on healthcheck failures.

samir: Monitoring to watch: latency_p50/p95, error_rate, model_mem_pressure, DB lock time. If any exceed threshold for 2 consecutive windows cancel and rollback.

li: DB command for rollback (if needed):
```
# restore previous schema pointer
psql -c "ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS new_idx_col;"
```

maya: Rollback plan: promote rc-2026-02-28-9, flip feature flag "new-routing" off, and revert model image tag. CI run to verify post-rollback smoke.

qa-jen: Smoke checklist: auth flow, search, embeddings response sanity, critical cron jobs run, background worker queue length. I'll start after canary 5% is healthy.

alex: I request one extra step — tag rollout in infra as "manual-approve" and require a second approver before 25% bump.

maya: Ack. I'll wait for @alex ack after 5% pass.

samir: :thumbsup: 5% canary go ahead once deploy-bot starts.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled for 22:00 PT. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> manual approval -> 25% for 10m -> 100%.

ops-sheriff: Logging who greenlit: maya, alex (pending second ack), samir, li, qa-jen.

alex: Verified the autoscale buffer and image pin. I'll give manual approve after 5m healthy signal.

qa-jen: Smoke ready on my side.

maya: Greenlight from me. Starting clock.

samir: I'll monitor live metrics. Ready to rollback if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: [22:01 PT] Canary 5% deployed. Health checks OK. Awaiting @alex manual approval to continue.

alex: Approving to continue to 25% — metrics stable.

deploy-bot: [22:18 PT] Canary 25% deployed. Running full smoke suite.

qa-jen: Smoke results: auth ✅, search ✅, embeddings sanity ✅, cron jobs ✅, queues healthy ✅

deploy-bot: [22:30 PT] Promotion to 100% initiated.

deploy-bot: [22:33 PT] Promotion complete. Post-deploy health: latency p95 within target, error_rate < 0.1%. Links: https://ci.redwood/status/rc-2026-03-17-1, https://dashboards/rc-2026-03-17-1

maya: Great. Thanks team. I'll file the release notes and mark the rollout complete.

samir: :tada: nice work.

ops-sheriff: Closing the window. If any regressions surface, follow the rollback steps pinned above.
